product: Restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore with the REST API (Public Preview)
tagline: Account admins can now restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore by its ID.
what_it_does: Account admins can now restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore by its ID. You can restore a metastore for up to 5 days after it's deleted. This article shows how to update, delete, and manage the behavior of Unity Catalog metastores in your Databricks account.
why_it_matters: Workspace admins will have the permissions required to create metastore level securable objects, like catalogs and external locations.
plain_summary: Account admins can now restore a deleted Unity Catalog metastore by its ID. You can restore a metastore for up to 5 days after it's deleted.
